question: The length of each of the two equal sides of an isosceles triangle is 85 cm and the length of its base is 72 cm. The area (in cm² ) of the triangle is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Height of an isosceles triangle (h) = √(a² − (b/2)²)

Where a = equal side = 85 cm, b = base = 72 cm

h = √(85² − 36²) = √((85 − 36) × (85 + 36)) = √(49 × 121) = 7 × 11 = 77 cm

Area = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 72 × 77 = 36 × 77 = 2772 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 2772 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of equal sides of the triangle (a) = 85 cm

Base of the triangle (b) = 72 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

Height of an isosceles triangle = √(a² − (b/2)²)</p
